messages:
tayler: Quick sync on postmortem follow-ups: action items around canary guardrails, ownership, and timelines. I want clear owners and ticket IDs before EOD.
maria: On it. I sketched a compact auto-rollback playbook and safe defaults here: https://redwood.internal/docs/rollout-guardrails-draft. Key signals: 5xx %, p95 latency, auth-fail rate.
josh: +1. Also adding routing-level rollback to ensure we can flip to last-known-good variant, not just pause. I'll prototype routing policy.
kai: I'll take the circuit-breaker piece for edge/proxy. Plan: implement a per-cluster breaker that enforces per-account caps. ETA 2w.
tayler: Can we enumerate action items now?
maria: Draft list:
- PR: Auto-rollback playbook (maria) -> due 1925417176 (7d)
- Ticket: Canary evaluation runner + cron (infra) -> due 1925503576 (8d)
- PR: Canary config defaults (josh) -> due 1926012376 (14d)
- Task: Edge circuit-breaker (kai) -> due 1926617176 (21d)
- Dashboard+alerts (sre-oncall) -> due 1925059776 (4d)
I'll create JIRA tickets now.
sre-oncall: Created alert rule CanaryDeviationHigh. Runbook linked. Will add panels for per-account error % and global rollout delta.
deploy-bot: CI job scheduled: canary-smoke @every 1m -> job id canary-smoke-2026-03. Logs to #eng-monitoring.
josh: Config snippet for safe defaults I'm proposing:
```yaml
rollout_defaults:
  global_max_pct: 12
  per_account_max_pct: 1
  auto_rollback:
    enabled: true
    immediate_on: ["5xx_spike","auth_failure"]
    staged_on: ["latency_regression"]
    error_threshold_pct: 2.5
    window_minutes: 10
  stable_fallback: last_stable_variant
```
maria: Good. I'll include smoke tests that run after each +10% increment in staging. Also adding unit tests for evaluator.
kai: For circuit-breaker, suggest per-region token bucket that rejects new canary enrollments when errors spike. Need support from routing team for stable_fallback switch.
josh: I'll coordinate routing changes. Also adding a canary telemetry tag to traces so we can slice easily.
tayler: Decision summary: immediate rollback for safety-critical signals (5xx spike, auth fail), staged pause for non-critical regressions; stable_fallback to previous variant where available. Owners + deadlines as listed.
maria: PR opened: https://redwood.internal/pulls/1024. Added TODOs for tests.
sre-oncall: Dashboard link posted to #eng-sre. Alert thresholds set to match playbook.
josh: Leaving review comments on PR. Will open routing PR once config changes land.
tayler: Thanks. Everyone please paste ticket numbers back here when created. We'll review progress in next eng-platform standup. :thumbsup:
